text:
Ava: Quick sync — thinking through pricing for appliance + partner HW bundles in the marketplace. Need cross-currency list prices and renewal window approach. @Priya can you loop in partner finance? cc @Ethan @Sofia
Priya: Looping partner in. They want to know whether we should price in USD or set local-market list prices per SKU. Also asking about commit tiers vs purely metered offers.
Ethan: From finance: prefer USD settlement/list price + localized display conversions at quote time. For committed discounts we should keep bands defined in USD to avoid complexity. Avoid multiple pricebooks if possible.
Sofia: Sales perspective: procurement in APAC/EMEA often needs local-currency quotes. We can surface display currency on the private-offer page but settle in USD. That keeps legal/finance simple while unblocking buyers.
Ava: Proposal: single private-offer SKU for appliance+HW, metadata fields: commit_floor, term_months, renewal_discount_schedule. Sketch: ```sku: APPL-HW-B1
commit_floor: 50000
term_months: 12
renewal_discount: year2=10%, year3=5%
currency: USD(settlement)
display_currencies: [EUR, GBP, JPY]```
Priya: Partner likes that. They also want an automatic step-down credit if usage drops below 80% of commit in year1 — can we codify that into the offer? :thinking_face:
Liam: Ops note — marketplace private-offers support conditional metadata but not automatic partner-credit workflows. Two approaches: (1) implement top-up/refund via finance (manual), or (2) model a cliff-triggered prorated credit that we calculate at T-1 month and apply as a one-off credit. Option 2 is easier to automate.
Ethan: Agree on cliff approach. Draft clause: "Usage check at month 11: if billable usage < 80% of committed USD => prorated credit issued to partner pool; next term commit band adjusted downward accordingly." We'll need partner sign-off.
Maya: Legal — we need explicit T&C language for FX risk, who receives the credit (partner vs customer), audit windows, and dispute resolution. I'll draft a clause and put in the PO metadata.
Sofia: For renewal motion: recommend 60/30/7 day notifications, an early-renewal sweet spot (60 days) with +5% ARR up-sell pricing, and a trade-in credit for older appliances to encourage migration. Sales needs clear messaging templates.
Ava: Action items: @Maya draft T&C + FX clause; @Liam confirm marketplace supports display_currency metadata and whether it shows on the private-offer UI; @Ethan own finance workflow for prorated credit; @Sofia prepare renewal cadence + messaging. I'll add the draft PO to our doc: https://docs.google.com/example (partner-visible).
Priya: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate partner acceptance and confirm local tax/VAT treatment on the credits.
PricingBot: Pricing sim complete — projected ARR uplift +22% if we enable display_currency + 60-day renewal window. Output saved to /pricing/run-1758675309.csv
Ava: Great, reconvene Thurs 10am PT. I'll create the invite. Thanks all :pray:
